proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the five traversal obligations in manual order. Open xizi_dll to initialize done=nil and todo=nodes. In transitions, unfold the nonempty suffix, fold explicit fields into xizi_dll_links, move the current node into the prefix with a local segment-snoc induction, and retain the remaining segment. For the general transition, derive the 32-bit no-wrap bound from the disjoint aligned pointer stores using store_ptr_align4, store_align4_merge, and store_align4_n_valid before rewriting unsigned_last_nbits; the first transition reduces to the concrete bound for 1. On exit, use the equal-boundary suffix to derive todo=nil and endpoint equality, then either append the last processed node and xizi_dll_close or fold the empty circular node. Keep reusable facts local to witness proof bodies unless a suffixed group-local case_lib helper is actually necessary. Avoid all forbidden lemmas and use structured unfold/fold, Intros/Exists, sep_apply, cancellation, and entailer.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: These are the initialization, two transition forms, and two exit forms of one xizi_double_link_len invariant. They share the same DLL predicates, segment endpoint facts, list equations, hidden no-wrap argument, and proof vocabulary. The group has 5 witnesses, below the maximum of 12.
